text: We have a ton of fun games inspired by the Rewind Era—Dream Phone, Girl Talk and even a paper fortune teller.
You can bring your AI questions to our town librarian, Miss Jeeves. She’ll help you find the answer.

Women have been shaping computing since the 1800s. Meet the MAiVENS and TRAiLBLAZERS behind the ideas that helped make today’s AI possible.
